snippet.title: Bufo Merge - Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Bufo Merge 🐸
Poki: https://poki.com/en/g/bufo-merge
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.neutronized.bufomerge
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bufo-merge/id6745303590

Combine frogs to create stronger and more powerful units as you defend your pond from waves of invading enemies. Start from frog eggs and merge them to unlock 25 levels of powerful amphibians, each with increased strength and fire rate. The higher the level, the better your chances of survival!

Features:
• Addictive merge gameplay
• 25 frog levels to discover
• Face off against challenging waves of enemies
• Use powerful boosts and power-ups to turn the tide
• Quirky pixel art
• Easy to play, hard to master
